fix_code:
def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    white, black = map(int, input().split())
    
    s = "wbwbwwbwbwbw"
    n = len(s)
    
    for i in range(n - (white + black) + 1):
        window = s[i:i + white + black]
        if window.count('w') == white and window.count('b') == black:
            print("Yes")
            return
    
    print("No")
